rationale.package: Re-baselined after the overlay-anchoring / dismissable / i18n / z-index pass. Growth is deliberate and accounted for: utils/anchor.js (new shared module), per-instance anchor and layer-stack wiring across 9 components, i18n adoption in 12 components against an 82-key catalogue, base/layouts.md growing from 62 to 148 lines to document base/grid.css, and the component contracts those changes touched — the knowledge graph embeds contract bodies verbatim, which is why both graph metrics move with the docs. Net: unpacked +0.25 MB (+1.0%), tarball +0.10 MB (+1.7%), full CSS +2.5 kB (+0.5%). Minified CSS went DOWN 245 bytes: the shared anchor names replaced duplicated declarations. The CHANGELOG entry for this work ships in the package too. Zero growth allowed from here.
